title: Azshara
body: Azshara lies on the northeastern shore of Kalimdor, a land of autumn-colored forests and high cliffs above the Great Sea that shares its name with the queen who ruled the Highborne. Their cities and temples lie broken along the coast: when the Sundering tore the world apart, most of Eldarath fell into the Bay of Storms, and their restless spirits still wander what remains. Naga sift the ruins, satyrs camp in the hills, blue dragons guard Lake Mennar, and only two small camps fly the colors of the great factions.

parts.body: For a time necropolises of the Scourge hang above the western hills and the Bay of Storms, and its armies spread across the land beneath them.

title: Talrendis Point
body: Talrendis Point is a small night elf camp at the western edge of Azshara, where the road from Ashenvale crosses into these haunted woods. Its most unusual guest is Loh'atu, a tauren sworn to the Earthmother to aid the elves against the satyrs, who calls them a blight on sacred lands Cenarius himself once walked, and who believes the Highborne spirits' hunger for the arcane is a harbinger of the Burning Legion.

title: Valormok
body: Valormok is a small Horde outpost against the mountains of western Azshara. It was once a dozen warriors strong, until the blood elf Magus Rimtori, whom Belgrom Rockmaul of Orgrimmar foolishly trusted, killed them all. Her expedition camps in the northern hills, combing the land for Highborne treasures and grinding the magic items it takes into a glittering dust; beside her camp, arcane crystals stand about a circle drawn from an ancient Kaldorei tome of summoning.

parts.body: The tome shows that one crystal of the circle is tied to Rimtori herself. The others are tied to something far more sinister.

title: Ruins of Eldarath
body: Eldarath was once a prosperous Highborne city and a strong fortress in central Azshara. The Sundering threw most of it into the Bay of Storms, and what remains clings to the cliffs above the water. The Spitelash naga claim it now, searching for the powerful artifacts the Highborne left behind, and their warlord rules from the old Temple of Zin-Malor, whose sacred writings still lie among the stones while the cursed spirits of the city linger.

title: Lake Mennar
body: Lake Mennar lies among the hills of southern Azshara, and its shores belong to the blue dragonflight: followers of Malygos stand guard on every side, and many suspect they protect something the Highborne left behind. Farther east the great blue Azuregos keeps his own watch over the coast, declaring the mysteries of the arcane inviolate and dragging intruders to his side with his magic.

title: Bay of Storms
body: The Bay of Storms is the great inlet of eastern Azshara, where much of old Eldarath lies drowned. Its islands hold strange residents: the night elf demon hunter Loramus Thalipedes keeps watch on one with three felhounds, and on another Duke Hydraxis of the Waterlords, servant of Neptulon, wages war on the lesser elements and above all on fire. On the northern shore the sea giant Lord Arkkoroc, whom some name a lesser god, rules from the Temple of Arkkoran.

parts.body: Hydraxis holds the fiery runes on the floor of the Molten Core to be conduits to the realm of fire, an affront to the Waterlords, and gives those who fight there the means to put them out.
